title: fix: switch weekly comparison between revenue and signups
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds Revenue / Signups buttons to the weekly comparison, with revenue selected by default.
- Shows only this week and last week on one axis; preserves full previous-week and partial current-week data.
- Keeps the chart below the main KPIs and shows signup freshness only in the signup view.
- Verified 31 tests, production build, Biome, and browser switching including keyboard and missing-data states.

gist.headline: Two weeks, two lenses
gist.blurb: The KPI garden gained a small switch: revenue by default, signups when you want to inspect the sprouts. Both weeks now share one sensible axis, which is apparently harder than it sounds.
gist.summary: Updated the internal KPI weekly comparison chart with Revenue and Signups views, defaulting to revenue while comparing full previous-week data against the current partial week on a shared axis.
gist.impact: Dashboard operators can switch between revenue and signup trends without losing the complete prior-week baseline, and signup freshness appears only when viewing signups.
gist.visual_concept: An internal analytics dashboard represented as a cozy retro terminal with a simple two-button Revenue/Signups toggle and two adjacent weekly bar-chart plants on one shared measuring ruler. Polli, wearing tiny analyst glasses and holding a clipboard, points to the revenue view while small flowers and vines grow around the monitor.
